verdict.rationale: Shopify does deliver order webhooks — UCP-shaped payloads pushed to a registered endpoint on committed order changes, HMAC-signed and retried — but the subscription mechanism itself is not agent-native: 'There's no self-serve subscription API today... contact your Shopify partner manager,' and although the UCP profile spec allows agents to declare a webhook_url, 'Shopify doesn't honor that field today.' This means an AI-native user cannot programmatically subscribe/register for webhook events themselves — it requires a manual, human, out-of-band process, undercutting the 'agentic' self-serve subscription story. missing for 10: self-serve/programmatic webhook subscription API, honoring the agent-declared webhook_url in the UCP profile, and any evidence of agent-driven (not partner-manager-mediated) event subscription.
